description: [PAID $0.001 USDC per call via x402] Decodes transaction calldata against an ABI that YOU supply and returns the function, its signature and each argument. If the selector is not in your ABI it says so and lists the selectors it does have; it does not guess from a selector database. An ABI that does not belong to the target contract can decode to plausible nonsense.

abi.description: JSON ABI objects, or human-readable signatures such as "function transfer(address to, uint256 amount)"

name: evm_calldata_decode
title: Decode calldata with your ABI
